AgentPrism.//: This file shows the schema only. Real values live in `dotnet user-secrets`. Do not write a secret here.

SqlServer.//: ConnectionString is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:SqlServer:ConnectionString" "Server=...". Not given at the SAME time as PostgreSql/Sqlite.

PostgreSql.//: ConnectionString is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:PostgreSql:ConnectionString" "Host=..."
PostgreSql.//EnableKnowledge: Off by default (K1); needs the pgvector extension (phase 67). Turned on here because this sample registers a knowledge-assistant agent (EnableVectorSearch).

Sqlite.//: ConnectionString is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Sqlite:ConnectionString" "Data Source=agentprism.db". Not given at the SAME time as the others.

ContentProtection.//: Enabled/ActiveKeyId/Keys are NOT secrets — Keys:sample only NAMES another configuration key. The raw AES-256 key it points at IS a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:ContentProtection:RawKeys:sample" "<32-byte base64 key, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 32`>". Only matters once a SQL provider above is also configured.

Ui.//AllowedOrigins: Empty by default (K1): no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is sent, so a cross-origin browser page (e.g. the embeddable chat widget on a shop's own site) is blocked by the browser. Add an exact origin to allow it.

RunRecording.//RecordReasoningDeltas: Off by default (K1) — this sample turns it on so the 'claude-thinking' agent's extended-thinking output shows up as ReasoningDelta events.

StructuredResponse.//Enabled: Off by default (K1) — this sample turns it on so the 'order-summary' agent's JSON response format is actually checked before the run closes.

Demo.//: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. Roles.Enabled registers AgentPrismPolicies.Reader/Operator/Admin and a header-based identity scheme (X-AgentPrism-Demo-Role: reader|operator|admin) that verifies NOTHING. Never turn this on in production; bind the same policy names to a real identity provider instead.

OpenAI.//: ApiKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Providers:OpenAI:ApiKey" "sk-..."
OpenAI.//Models: AgentPrism carries no built-in model list (decision K-032). The catalog comes from here; the UI shows this list on the model selection screen.

Providers.//Anthropic: Anthropic (Claude). ApiKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Providers:Anthropic:ApiKey" "sk-ant-..."

Anthropic.//DefaultMaxOutputTokens: max_tokens is REQUIRED by the Anthropic Messages API. This value is used when ModelBinding.MaxOutputTokens is left empty.
Anthropic.//Models: AgentPrism carries no built-in model list (decision K-032). The list is not a validation list.

Providers.//Google: Google Gemini. ApiKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Providers:Google:ApiKey" "AIza..."

Google.//Models: Gemini model names age out quickly: measured (2026-08-05) gemini-2.5-flash is no longer available to new users.

Providers.//AzureOpenAI: Azure OpenAI. Endpoint is REQUIRED; Azure has no single global address. ApiKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Providers:AzureOpenAI:ApiKey" "..."

AzureOpenAI.//Endpoint: Has the form https://<resource-name>.openai.azure.com/. Left empty in this file because it exposes the corporate topology; provide it via user-secrets.
AzureOpenAI.//DefaultDeployment: NOT a model name: it is the DEPLOYMENT name defined on the Azure resource. The person who provisioned the resource chooses the name.
AzureOpenAI.//Audience: Used only on the Microsoft Entra (managed identity) path. Empty means the Azure public cloud. For Azure Government: https://cognitiveservices.azure.us/.default
AzureOpenAI.//Models: The Name field of each entry is the DEPLOYMENT name; the sample names are placeholders and differ per resource.

Providers.//OpenAICompatible: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM, Ollama...). Each name has its own subsection; UseOpenAICompatible(name, ...) reads this section.

openrouter.//: ApiKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Providers:OpenAICompatible:openrouter:ApiKey" "sk-or-..."
openrouter.//DefaultModel: OpenRouter model ids carry a provider prefix: not "gpt-5.4-mini" but "openai/gpt-5.4-mini".

AgentPrism.//Voice: Voice tools. ApiKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set "AgentPrism:Voice:ApiKey" "...". Without a key no voice tool is registered and /api/voice/* endpoints return 501.

Voice.//Endpoint: The provider's public address is used when empty.
Voice.//DefaultVoiceId: Used when the request does not supply a voice id. Ids are listed by the `list_voices` tool or GET /api/voice/voices.
Voice.//OutputFormat: 🚨 Raw pcm_*/ulaw_* outputs carry NO file header and are rejected by the attachment store; settings validation rejects them at startup.
Voice.//RequireApproval: Voice synthesis has no irreversible external effect, it only spends money. Off by default.
Voice.//Conversation: ⚠️ Real-time conversation. CHANGES THE HOSTING MODEL: the connection stays open for minutes and binds to ONE server instance (sticky session). The capability is enabled only when UseVoiceConversation() is called; otherwise there is no WebSocket endpoint at all.

Conversation.//PersistAudio: 🚨 Voice is personal data; OFF by default. When enabled, ONLY the audio produced by the agent is written to `attachments` - the user's voice is never stored.
Conversation.//MaxUtteranceDuration: End-of-speech detection lives on the CLIENT; this limit is only a safety net.
Conversation.//OutputMediaType: 🚨 Must state the SAME type as OutputFormat; streaming synthesis reports no type and if the browser cannot decode the audio it fails silently.

Images.//: Off by default (K1). When Enabled is true, Provider selects a registered image adapter and Model is an explicit image model or Azure deployment. Prices are optional and use AgentPrism:Pricing:Images.

AgentPrism.//Pricing: Voice and image prices are explicit consumer values. AgentPrism does not invent them (K-032); an unconfigured image price records cost as NULL.

Pricing.//Images: Example path: Images:{provider}:{model}:PerImage and optional SizeMultipliers:{provider-size}; token-billed models use OutputCostPerMillionTokens instead. Do not set both price modes.
